Name: Elam, the Singer
Summary: Elam was one of the singers at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall, listed with Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, and Ezer. NOTE ON IDENTITY: this singer is not the Elam son of Shem of Genesis 10; the text does not connect them, so this is a separate profile for the Nehemiah 12:42 singer only.
LifeLesson: Rebuilt walls are dedicated with singing.
